main_text.p: duntæ Carnutum congregatis notatum fuisse censurâ, quæ omnium Episcopo-rumChirographis subscripta,&ad Richelium postea delata, intra manus ejus substiterit; his præterea adjungit Morinus, Sorbonicos bene multas libri illius propositiones notâsse, eorumque censuram plusquàm 80 doctorum suffragiis comprobatam, Sorbonæ Registris inscriptam fuisse,quam tamen in publicum edere per supremam autoritatem non licuerit: Cardinalem Richelium Sorbonæ doctores aliquot deputâsse, qui cum Celloto de his propositionibus conferrent; Jesuitas asserere, Cellotum Sorbonicis doctoribus satisfecisse, contra affirmare Sorbonicos, malas propositiones[?] à Celloto male propugnatas: de quaCollatione nihil publicè editum fuerat. Rescripsit Morino {a} Cardinalis Barberinus, etiam nondum lecto Cel'oti opere, intra brevissimum tempus fore, ut suprema Ecclesiæ autoritas ejusmodi scriptorum, qui nihil ad res Ecclesiasticas tractandas.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Spelling of u/v and i/j normalised. "qvaCollatione" and "qvi" read as quaCollatione and qui; the printed space between "qua" and "Collatio" is missing in the scan and kept as printed. The word "propositiones" has an ink blot over the "t", so the reading is doubtful and marked. The page number "50" is printed in old-style figures and is slightly blurred. The final catchword "præ-" is at the lower right. The word "Episcopo-rumChirographis" has no space at the line end as printed.
